SorboBot is the research expertise agent of [crisalid-agents](https://github.com/CRISalid-esr/crisalid-agents)
(`sorbobot` package). It answers, in English or French, questions about the researchers of the institution, from the
knowledge graph:

- the **experts of a research theme**, ranked with a score out of 100 ("who works on urban heat islands?");
- the **expertise of a named researcher** (their main OpenAlex research domains and publications);
- a **profile** of a researcher for a given question, with a numbered list of references;
- the meaning of the **OpenAlex research domains** returned, and the domains covered by a theme.

It is served by the chat API (`crisalid-agents-chat-api`) and, by default, allowed to the OpenWebUI client only
(`AGENT_ALLOW_LIST`), where it appears as the **Sorbobot** model. The SoVisuPlus assistant does not use it.

## How it works

The LLM never writes Cypher and never calls the MCP tools itself. It only sees four business tools; each one runs a
deterministic search in Python over two services:

- **[CRISalid Taxi](docker-compose.qmd#crisalid-taxi)**, which turns the text of the question into the closest
  OpenAlex topics by semantic similarity (the same service IKG uses to classify documents);
- the **`sorbobot` toolset** of the MCP toolbox (`neo4j-mcp`): curated Cypher tools that read the topics, the
  `HAS_TOPIC` links of the documents, the authors and the abstracts.

An LLM judge filters the topics and the publications that do not match the question, and a pure ranking orders the
researchers. Error messages (taxi or graph unavailable, message empty or too long) are predefined, in the language of
the question.

## Prerequisites

SorboBot only works when the graph holds topics assigned by taxi. Before serving it:

1. **Deploy CRISalid Taxi**: the `crisalid-taxi` profile, with the OpenAlex snapshot downloaded first (see
   [Topics classification](docker-compose.qmd#crisalid-taxi)). The taxi service joins the `agents-network` Docker
   network so that the agent reaches it at `http://crisalid-taxi:8000`.
2. **Classify the documents**: set `TAXI_ENABLED=true` in `docker/ikg/.env` so that IKG links every document it
   writes to its OpenAlex topics (`HAS_TOPIC` relationships with `source=crisalid`). By default SorboBot only takes
   these links into account (`SORBOBOT_TOPIC_SOURCES=crisalid`); documents written before taxi was enabled must be
   harvested again to get their topics.
3. **A toolbox shipping the `sorbobot` toolset**: the `crisalidesr/crisalid-neo4j-mcp-toolbox:dev` image, or a
   release published after it. Every tool of the toolset requires a JWT with the `crisalid-graph-mcp` audience, obtained
   by the chat API through token exchange from the person's token: the `crisalid-agents` Keycloak client must be
   configured (`CRISALID_AGENTS_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID` / `_SECRET` in `docker/crisalid-agents/.env`, see [Security](security.qmd)).
4. **The usual agent settings**: LLM endpoint and model, embedding endpoint (used by taxi), see
   [Docker Compose](docker-compose.qmd).

## Configuration

Everything lives in `docker/crisalid-agents/.env` (copy of `.env.sample`):

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CRISALID_AGENTS_AGENTS` | `generic_agent,project_topic_matching,sorbobot` | Agents loaded by the chat API; keep `sorbobot` in the list |
| `AGENT_ALLOW_LIST` | `sovisuplus:…;open-webui:generic_agent,project_topic_matching,sorbobot` | Agents each Keycloak client may call; keep `sorbobot` in the `open-webui` set |
| `CRISALID_TAXI_URL` | `http://crisalid-taxi:8000` | Internal URL of the taxi service |
| `SORBOBOT_TAXI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `SORBOBOT_TOOLBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `SORBOBOT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | 15, 30, 30 | Timeouts of the taxi, toolbox and LLM judge calls |
| `SORBOBOT_TAXI_MAX_TOPICS`, `SORBOBOT_TAXI_MIN_QUERY_CHARS`, `SORBOBOT_SEMANTIC_THRESHOLD` | 100, 25, 0.56 | Taxi request: topics asked, minimum text length, minimum text-to-topic similarity |
| `SORBOBOT_MAX_SEARCH_TOPICS`, `SORBOBOT_TOPIC_LINK_THRESHOLD` | 20, 0.57 | Topics kept from taxi, minimum publication-to-topic similarity |
| `SORBOBOT_TOPIC_SOURCES` | `crisalid` | `HAS_TOPIC` link sources taken into account (comma-separated; empty keeps every source) |
| `SORBOBOT_JUDGE_THRESHOLD` | 0.6 | Minimum LLM judge score; `0` disables both judges |
| `SORBOBOT_MIN_AUTHORS`, `SORBOBOT_MAX_JUDGED_SIBLINGS` | 2, 100 | Widening to sibling topics when too few researchers are found |
| `SORBOBOT_RANKING_METHOD` | `weighted_relevance` | Ranking of the researchers (`weighted_relevance` or `count`) |
| `SORBOBOT_SHOW_MAX_AUTHORS`, `SORBOBOT_SHOW_MAX_DOMAINS`, `SORBOBOT_SHOW_MAX_PERSON_PUBLICATIONS`, `SORBOBOT_PROFILE_MAX_PUBLICATIONS`, `SORBOBOT_EXPLORE_MAX_DOMAINS` | 10, 5, 20, 20, 10 | Result sizes |
| `SORBOBOT_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS` | 1000 | Maximum length of a user message |
| `SORBOBOT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES`, `SORBOBOT_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE` | `en,fr`, `en` | Answer languages and fallback language |

The `SORBOBOT_*` variables are all optional: `crisalid-agents.yaml` passes them to the chat API, and an empty
value keeps the agent's built-in default. The toolbox URL and toolset are taken from `CRISALID_MCP_TOOLBOX_URL` and
fixed to `sorbobot`, whatever `CRISALID_MCP_TOOLBOX_TOOLSET` says for the graph agent.

::: {.callout-note}
The thresholds of the taxi request (`SORBOBOT_SEMANTIC_THRESHOLD`, `SORBOBOT_TAXI_MAX_TOPICS`,
`SORBOBOT_TAXI_MIN_QUERY_CHARS`) are sent with every request and override the defaults of the taxi service
(`docker/crisalid-taxi/.env`) for SorboBot only.
:::

## Serving SorboBot

Start the taxi, the toolbox, the chat API and OpenWebUI together (Keycloak being up, see
[Docker Compose](docker-compose.qmd)):

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.dev.yaml \
  --profile crisalid-taxi --profile neo4j-mcp \
  --profile crisalid-agents-chat-api --profile openwebui \
  up -d
```

The taxi service only serves once it has embedded the whole OpenAlex taxonomy, which can take several minutes on the
first start. Until then SorboBot answers that the topics service is unavailable.

In OpenWebUI, the agent appears as the **Sorbobot** model next to the graph agent and the Horizon topic finder; apply
the [agent model settings](configuring-openwebui.qmd#agent-model-configuration) to it like to the other agents.
